descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Graffiti puts a table of spray cans on a sunny Brooklyn sidewalk and gives you the whole block to paint.

THE WALLS
An old red-brick warehouse with four big blank bays, three shops with roll-down steel shutters, and a buff-brick garage. The paint sits in the brick, so every mortar line shows through your piece.

THE CANS
Grab a can and pull the trigger to spray. Press X to open a wheel of 44 colours and load the can in your hand. Press A to swap caps: skinny for outlines, medium, and fat for fills. Hold the can still up close and the paint drips down the wall.

STENCILS
Take a stencil off the rack (star, crown, lightning bolt, heart, arrow or NYC), press it flat on a wall and let go. It sticks. Spray over it, peel it off, and the shape is on the wall.

PHOTOS
Press Y facing a wall and a photo of your piece is saved to your headset's Pictures folder.

DAY AND NIGHT
Switch to night and the street lamps, wall lights and shop signs come on over your work.

FRESH COAT
Tap the red post to wipe every wall clean, or clear just the wall in front of you from the menu.

FEATURES
- A Brooklyn street with 9 paintable walls: brick and steel shutters
- 8 spray cans, a 44-colour wheel and 3 cap sizes
- Real drips, 6 stencils and a photo button
- Day and night, with traffic driving past
- Shake the can to hear it rattle
- Background music with its own menu
- Walk with the left stick, snap turn with the right
